feature_decisions.name: season_duration_days
feature_decisions.formula: season_end_date - season_start_date
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Length of the local growing window contextualizes how much of the crop cycle has elapsed.
feature_decisions.availability: known from static calendar before prediction

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: tavg_mean_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: mean(meteorology.tavg from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Season-to-date thermal conditions influence development and yield formation.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: tmax_max_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: max(meteorology.tmax from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Extreme heat exposure can stress maize during sensitive growth periods.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: negative when heat is excessive; nonlinear otherwise
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: diurnal_range_mean_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: mean(tmax - tmin from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Mean diurnal temperature range represents day/night thermal conditions not captured by tavg alone.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: cwb_sum_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: sum(meteorology.cwb from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Accumulated crop water balance represents season-to-date water surplus or deficit.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: et0_sum_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: sum(meteorology.et0 from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Accumulated atmospheric water demand can indicate increasing crop water stress when water supply is limited.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: rad_sum_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: sum(meteorology.rad from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Accumulated radiation represents energy available for crop growth up to forecast time.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: tavg_mean_last_30d
feature_decisions.formula: mean(meteorology.tavg over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Recent thermal conditions may influence current crop development and near-term stress.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: cwb_sum_last_30d
feature_decisions.formula: sum(meteorology.cwb over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date)
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Recent water surplus/deficit can capture short-term water stress.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: latest_ssm
feature_decisions.formula: latest soil_moisture.ssm with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Surface soil moisture near forecast time represents immediate water availability.
feature_decisions.availability: observation dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: latest_rsm
feature_decisions.formula: latest soil_moisture.rsm with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Root-zone soil moisture near forecast time represents crop-accessible water reserves.
feature_decisions.availability: observation dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: rsm_mean_last_30d
feature_decisions.formula: mean soil_moisture.rsm over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Recent root-zone water reserves represent water accessible during ongoing crop development.
feature_decisions.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: latest_ndvi
feature_decisions.formula: latest ndvi.ndvi with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Vegetation greenness by forecast time is a proxy for crop canopy development.
feature_decisions.availability: observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: ndvi_change_since_first_observation
feature_decisions.formula: latest in-season NDVI - first in-season NDVI, both dated <= cutoff_date
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Change in canopy greenness captures crop development trajectory, not only current state.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: positive when it reflects healthy canopy development
feature_decisions.availability: requires at least two in-season NDVI observations dated <= cutoff

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: latest_fpar
feature_decisions.formula: latest fpar.fpar with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Absorbed photosynthetically active radiation by forecast time is a canopy productivity proxy.
feature_decisions.availability: observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: fpar_mean_to_cutoff
feature_decisions.formula: mean fpar.fpar from season_start_date through cutoff_date
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Season-to-date mean absorbed radiation represents accumulated canopy development.
feature_decisions.availability: dekadal observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: crop_area_percentage
feature_decisions.formula: static crop_mask.crop_area_percentage by administrative unit
feature_decisions.hypothesis: The share of administrative area under maize may contextualize regional yield heterogeneity and representativeness.
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute
feature_decisions.leakage_risk: low; static mask is not year-specific

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: bulk_density
feature_decisions.formula: static soil.bulk_density by administrative unit
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Soil bulk density can constrain root penetration and water movement, affecting crop performance.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: negative when high bulk density limits roots; context-dependent
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: available_water_capacity_cm_m
feature_decisions.formula: static soil.awc by administrative unit
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Higher available water capacity can increase soil water storage accessible to the crop.
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute

validation_ablation.interpretation: positive delta means validation error increased when removed

feature_decisions.name: latitude_deg
feature_decisions.formula: static centroid latitude by administrative unit
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Latitude can represent spatial gradients in climate and growing conditions across Argentina.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: spatially varying; no monotonic sign assumed
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute
feature_decisions.leakage_risk: low; transfer to unseen regions requires spatial validation

feature_decisions.name: longitude_deg
feature_decisions.formula: static centroid longitude by administrative unit
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Longitude can represent west-east environmental gradients across Argentina.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: spatially varying; no monotonic sign assumed
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute
feature_decisions.leakage_risk: low; transfer to unseen regions requires spatial validation

feature_decisions.name: drainage_class_code
feature_decisions.formula: source categorical drainage class code; one-hot encode in a training pipeline
feature_decisions.hypothesis: Drainage regime can affect waterlogging and root-zone water availability.
feature_decisions.expected_relationship: class-specific; labels and ordering not assumed
feature_decisions.availability: static source attribute
feature_decisions.interpretability: low until code labels are obtained

decisions_and_limitations: Use the 2003-2022 sensor era so the target cohort is temporally comparable across available sources.
Keep the same mapped target campaigns at all three cutoff fractions; source gaps remain as NaN and are reported.
Do not use admin_id, planting/harvest labels, future observations, or target-derived historical statistics as predictors.
Use cwb rather than raw precipitation in the primary candidates because precipitation units remain provisional.
Exclude vpd, awc, drainage codes, and coordinates until their units/codebook/CRS are resolved.
Do not remove zero or high target yields; CY-Bench v1.8 filters invalid values and no further evidence justifies filtering.
Do not use MAPE because the yield target contains zeros.
Rolling-origin OOF validation is used for cutoff, group, and feature-ablation decisions.
The 2019-2022 holdout was previously accessed for the initial all-candidate bundle; its current metrics are exploratory, not a pristine final test.
Feature-level ablation and validation correlation are diagnostics; they do not automatically establish causality or final acceptance.
Per-region holdout errors assess stability only in regions represented in development; transfer to unseen regions is not evaluated.
This evaluation does not tune estimator hyperparameters and does not constitute final model selection.
post_evaluation_metadata_updates: AWC in cm m-1 was included in the latest validation comparison.
Raw latitude/longitude and drainage code are included as unscored candidates because CRS/codebook validation is pending.
